establishes: Magic full-RC extraction methodology for the exact archived two-column IHP SG13G2 demonstration layout under all five public interconnect styles
explicit resistor-network preservation of the programmed-drain and absent-via connectivity distinction, including extracted nonzero NMOS substrate/body paths
local full-RC electrical behavior over the same 33 deterministic device-PVT, supply, temperature, and output-load points used by the capacitance-only IHP campaign
semantic extraction replay despite any non-semantic SPICE statement ordering differences
forbidden_inferences: compact ROM cell, row, column, decoder, sense-amplifier, repair, clock, or full-array resistance and capacitance
full-array simultaneous-current, IR-drop, noise, electromigration, aging, thermal, or power-delivery behavior
N7 or N4 density, bandwidth, delay, energy, leakage, yield, or cost
whole-wafer timing, inference throughput, or GPU speedup
target-foundry late-via availability, sign-off extraction, manufacturing sign-off, or silicon correlation

extraction.style_total_net_note: All five styles emit the same 10-device, 41-resistor, 68-capacitor RC netlist element counts. The two high-R styles extract and output 15 of 41 top-cell networks; nominal and both low-R styles extract and output 14 of 41. Both primitive subcells extract and output one substrate/well network.
